texts.facts: This writ petition has been filed challenging the impugned notice issued by the first respondent in Na.Ka.No.807/Thi Va-2/2025, dated 25.01.2025, directing the petitioner to vacate the canteen operating n the Tirunelveli Government medical college. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2. The petitioners case is that a canteen was allotted to her in the P.W.D. building near the labour ward of the Government Hospital and it was running without causing any disturbance to the public. She also registered the canteen under the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India Act, 2006, from the date of the lease agreement to the present. However, due to personal vengeance from nearby shopkeepers, hotel, and tea shop vendors, the petitioner has faced repeated anonymous disturbances aimed at pressuring her to shut down the canteen. The petitioners grievance is that the first respondent, through a communication dated 25.01.2025, directed her to vacate the premises within 24 hours, without affording her any opportunity for a hearing. Aggrieved by this, the petitioner has filed the present writ petition.
